title: Genesis 23:1-4 — Sarah dies at Hebron; Abraham asks for a burial site
summary: Genesis 23:1-4: Sarah lived 127 years and died at Kiriath-arba (Hebron) in Canaan; Abraham mourned her and asked the sons of Heth for a burial site, calling himself a stranger and sojourner. Sarah's and Abraham's names are coloured with the final “h” set apart.

text.text: 1 Now Sarah lived one hundred and twenty-seven years; these were the years of the life of Sarah.
2 Sarah died in Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan; and Abraham went in to mourn for Sarah and to weep for her.
3 Then Abraham rose from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,
4 “I am a stranger and a sojourner among you; give me a burial site among you that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
